Developer push → GitHub Actions 觸發 2. Build：dotnet + Tailwind 編譯 → publish 目錄 3. Image Build：Dockerfile multi-stage（builder → aspnet:8.0-jammy runtime） 4. push ghcr.io/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager:${SHA} 5. ArgoCD 偵測 helm values 變更 → kubectl apply 6. K8s rolling update → 健康檢查 → 完成 ## CSP / Security Headers（FRONTEND §6.4 + EDD §6） | Header | 值 | |--------|---| | `Content-Security-Policy` | `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{RANDOM}' cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' fonts.googleapis.com; font-src fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'` | | `Strict-Transport-Security` | `max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` | | `X-Content-Type-Options` | `nosniff` | | `X-Frame-Options` | `DENY` | | `Referrer-Policy` | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` | | `Permissions-Policy` | `clipboard-write=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()` |
